answer: The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 250 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. Because the karst measurement is bound to the mesa signature, the sparrow audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. A farm that substitutes a cheap script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
